description: Finish the current task and optionally create one follow-up task.

result.description: Final answer as a native JSON value. Omit only when there is nothing to report. A handover requires a non-null, non-empty value.

handover.description: Fields for one follow-up task. If follow-up fields are already shown, omitting this object keeps them unchanged. Include it only to supply or change a shown field.

label.description: Agent label that may claim the follow-up task. A fixed value shown for this field cannot be changed.

task.description: Follow-up instructions as any JSON value. In string values, `{parent_id}` becomes the current task ID, `{parent_result}` its final result, and `{parent_result_path}` its result-file path.

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema that the follow-up result must satisfy.
